parole.testo: A wanderword widespread in Eastern Europe. The source language is unclear, the word may have come to Hungarian from Slavic. Ultimately, from the mixing of Byzantine Greek τάγιστρον (tágistron, “nosebag”) and Latin canistrum (“wicker basket”). The earlier form tanisztra had the -t- drop to eliminate
